top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An outdoor structure that consisted of a slide and climbing that measured over 5 feet, did not have the required 9 inches of loose-fill. There was not sufficient enough loose-fill around the structure to rake in place at the time of the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The van for transportation does not have a child safety alarm equipped.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used for transportation has not been serviced. Fire extinguisher is empty at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguishers have not been inspected monthly.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
